output_measure: first-mark density at the fixed elapsed time; time is not integrated; row sums need not be at most one

relative_projective_certificate.comparison: lower_multiplier * Khat <= Ktrue <= upper_multiplier * Khat entrywise, for every input and output configuration
relative_projective_certificate.common_support: all input configurations; outputs with marked leaf reset to0; other output states unrestricted
relative_projective_certificate.normalization_rule: apply the unnormalized kernel to the whole input law, then normalize once by its event-time density
relative_projective_certificate.source_scope: binary positive local rates, unchanged silentQ across one irreversible autonomous opening, specified local mark/reset; all later operators share the same physical input state
